Clear costs. Owner control. Platform fees are 3.5% on Starter, 2.5% on Growth and 1.5% on Scale, plus Stripe processing. Optional add-ons and usage charges are separate; check plan details before activating.

Revenue snapshots and growth scenarios are planning tools, not business valuations or promises of a sale price or financing. Photo insights require activation and allowance, owner review and live validation. Weather and route recommendations support your decisions; they do not automatically change confirmed appointments.
